validated_objective: Release QIF v0.8.5 with immutable trust-policy succession and reproducible historical replay that routes changed or incomplete results to governance.
scope: qif-ledger policy lineage and replay entities
deterministic verifier, negative fixtures, docs, portable package, roadmap, AOF evidence, and release
constraints: provider-neutral with no live cryptography, key management, external registry, UI, or history mutation
no automatic activation, authorization, authority, or semantic truth
expected_outcomes: original decisions remain immutable and resolve their original policy revision
later-policy replay reproduces outcome deltas and fail-closed governance
